title: Arcee, which develops open-weight models in the US, partners with the Department of Energy to build Genesis-Science-1, an open model for scientific research (Catherine Perloff/The Information)
summary: Catherine Perloff / The Information: Arcee, which develops open-weight models in the US, partners with the Department of Energy to build Genesis-Science-1, an open model for scientific research — Arcee, an American open-weigh AI provider, announced a partnership with the Department of Energy, in which the DOE will use Arcee's AI models to advance scientific…
